dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides deep, AWS‑specific lifecycle expertise (minimum‑duration charges, 128 KB IA surcharge, monitoring fee, transition day counting, object‑size gating, Intelligent‑Tiering nuances, Glacier retrieval costs) that a generic model would not know. Minor gap: references to external pricing matrix without including it.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides a clear AWS‑specific workflow (pre‑flight, step‑wise optimisation, rollback, confirmation gate) and concrete CLI commands. One point is deducted because a few steps (e.g., generic “Verify” commands) are not uniquely AWS‑oriented.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Extensive NEVER list with concrete reasoning (IA small‑object surcharge, minimum‑duration, multipart leaks, etc.). One point is deducted for omitting a few niche anti‑patterns such as the cost of S3 Batch Operations back‑fill or the subtle CRR storage‑class propagation edge case.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Complete front‑matter, clear description, when‑to‑use, activation triggers, and invocation schema. The only shortfall is the absence of an explicit “example invocation” field, which would make activation even more reliable.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered (quick reference, decision tree, detailed steps, error handling). However, the initial sections are dense, causing some cognitive overload before the concise top‑level summary appears.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (put‑bucket‑lifecycle‑configuration) are tightly constrained with mandatory CONFIRM, pre‑flight state capture, rollback procedure, and rate‑limit guidance. Calibration matches task fragility perfectly.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a coherent, recognizable structure (What it does, Quick reference, Decision tree, Mindset, Process, Anti‑patterns, Edge‑cases, Error handling, Rollback).

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete CLI commands, JSON payloads, and verification steps, enabling an agent to act. Yet the sample model outputs contain arithmetic mismatches and violate the verdict‑consistency rules (e.g., OPPORTUNITY_FOUND with $0 savings), showing ambiguity in the skill’s enforcement of those rules. Missing explicit validation steps for savings calculations reduces practical reliability.
